NC: 2025:KHC:50052 HC-KAR 3.

The petitioner has approached this Court challenging the General Award dated 06.01.2023 (Annexure-E) passed by the 3rd respondent in respect of the land in Sy.No.114, measuring 2 acres,
situated at Machanahalli village, Sompura Hobli, Nelamangala Taluk, Bangalore Rural District,
insofar as it pertains to the petitioner.
4.

Heard learned counsel Sri. Sharan N Majage., for the petitioner, learned Additional Government Advocate Sri.Harisha A.S. for respondent No.1 and learned counsel Sri.H.L.Pradeep Kumar for Sri R Nagaraj vs The State Of Karnataka on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129813431/

sentences.text: respondents No.2 and 3.
Perused the material on record.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the compensation was earlier determined through a consent agreement entered into between the petitioners and the State under Section 29(2) of the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Act, 1966 (for short "the KIAD Act").

However, respondent No.3 subsequently, NC: 2025:KHC:50052 HC-KAR passed the impugned General Award on 06.01.2023, which according to the petitioner could not have been issued once a consent award was agreed upon.

He further submits that as per the Government Order dated 23.02.2021 (Annexure-F)
the extent of developed land is increased to 10,781 sq. ft. per acre, and therefore, being the lawful owner of the acquired land whose katha stands in his name, the petitioner is entitled to such allotment of developed land in the industrial layout formed by respondent-KIADB.
6.

Learned counsel appearing for the respondent-KIADB does not dispute the existence of the Government Order dated 23.02.2021, which governs the allotment of developed land, in lieu of monetary compensation.
However, he submits that the petitioner has not yet submitted any representation before the competent authority, seeking such allotment.
It is further submitted that if the petitioner submits an appropriate NC: 2025:KHC:50052 HC-KAR representation, the same will be duly considered in accordance with law.
7. Submission is recorded.

8. Accordingly, this Court passes the following:
ORDER (i) The writ petition is allowed.
(ii) The impugned General Award dated 06.01.2023 (Annexure-E) passed by respondent No.3 is hereby quashed.
(iii) The petitioner is granted liberty to submit a fresh representation to respondent- KIADB, within a period of 30 days from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.
Upon receipt of such representation, the respondent- KIADB shall consider the same in terms of Government Order dated 23.02.2021 as per Annexure-F and pass appropriate orders.
NC: 2025:KHC:50052 HC-KAR (iv) The said consideration by the KIADB shall be within eight weeks from the date of submission of the representation by the petitioner.
(v) The respondent-KIADB is at liberty to withdraw the amount, if any, deposited before the Competent Court.
